answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and hangs a marble slab from a vine trellis, its end at a vine knot. The gale cold front drops the temperature 15 degrees and the marble contracts; the auditor measures the gap to the knot and recomputes it from the expansion table. A 5,000 mm slab contracts 0.6 mm; 5% off burns the bond. First 36, the k-th 36+6(k-1); the 1,000th 6,030, 1,000 filings 3,033,000, 70,000 locked. A rented-slab ring fails: one slab backs one filing in a gale; a second filing under another key burns both bonds. An honest agent with one marble slab pays 36 once, bond kept.
